paragraphs: Dear Diary, this is Lily, and today was a very long Saturday. I was bored in the morning, because it rained all day. There were a million drops on the window. I looked at the rain for a long time. I do not like rain on Saturday, but I like rain at night. Tom played a game on the laptop and did not talk to me. Pip lay on the floor with his furry ears on his paws.

At ten o'clock, Mia came with her white kitten, Snow. I was so excited, and I smiled for the first time that day. Snow was small, soft, and furry, and she liked my pink bag. "What can we do?" asked Mia. "Let's make a town from boxes," I said. We spent two hours on the floor with boxes, paper, and glue. Mom made noodles for lunch, and we ate them on the floor. It was fun.

Snow walked across our town twice, and she knocked down a house. Then she ran under the sofa and did not come out. I felt a bit afraid too. Mia was worried, and her face was very serious. "Snow, where are you?" she called. Pip looked under the sofa and barked once. Snow came out slowly, and she was fine. Mia took her in her arms and laughed.

In the afternoon, Tom stopped his game and looked at our town. "This is great," he said. "Can I put a bridge here?" I said yes, and we made the bridge from a long box. Tom was not bored now. Now I am tired, but I am very happy. I did not like the morning, but I really like the evening.
Rain is still on the window, and I can hear it. Tomorrow, I want to write about the town on Explorers' Blog. Good night, Diary. Lily
